name: Tomb of Tyr
summary: The Tomb of Tyr, also known as Keeper's Rest, is a sealed subterranean vault buried deep beneath the waters of Tyr's Fall in the Whispering Forest. It was constructed eons ago to entomb the fallen titan-forged Keeper Tyr alongside the monstrous C'Thraxxi horror he died destroying.

sections.title: A Monument to Sacrifice
sections.body: Following the cataclysmic battle between Keeper Tyr and Zakajz the Corruptor, Tyr's surviving titan-forged companions laid the keeper to rest beneath the earth of Tirisfal. Alongside him, they entombed his sacred warhammer—the Silver Hand—and sealed away the remains of Zakajz. Potent wards were bound directly to the weapon to ensure the crypt remained undisturbed. The vrykul warrior Yrgrim the Truthseeker and his followers remained behind to guard the vault, establishing the secretive order known as Tyr's Guard, which eventually passed its sacred vigil onto early humanity.

sections.title: The Folly of Thoradin
sections.body: Centuries later, High King Thoradin sought out the legends of the buried titan and forced his way past Tyr's Guard into the subterranean complex. Recklessly commanding his imperial magi to unravel the ancient protective seals, Thoradin accidentally revived the dormant monstrosity Zakajz. In the desperate, bloody battle that followed, Thoradin sacrificed his life by driving his greatsword, Strom'kar, directly into the horror's skull. The blade's enchantments forced the beast into an enduring slumber, sealing both the king and the monster within the darkness below.

faq.q: Who is buried in the Tomb of Tyr?
aliases: what is in the tomb of tyr
faq.answer: The vault holds the remains of Keeper Tyr, a great titan-forged guardian of ancient Azeroth, alongside his great silver warhammer. It also entombs the body of Zakajz the Corruptor, a colossal C'Thraxxi abomination, as well as the ancient human High King Thoradin.

faq.q: Where is the entrance to the tomb?
aliases: how to get into tyr's tomb
faq.answer: The tomb lies deep beneath the Whispering Forest in western Tirisfal Glades. Its hidden entrance rests underwater at the bottom of the lake known as Tyr's Fall.

Tyr's Guard was a secretive brotherhood founded by ancient vrykul who stayed behind after Tyr's death. As the curse of flesh transformed them, they inducted the earliest humans into their order, passing down the duty of guarding the tomb and keeping Zakajz sealed away.

faq.q: What happened to King Thoradin in the tomb?
faq.answer: Thoradin entered the tomb seeking power and broke the wards holding Zakajz dead, accidentally reawakening the beast. Thoradin gave his life to drive his sword, Strom'kar, into the horror's brain, locking the beast into a deep magical slumber.

angles.text: The tomb holds monumental significance for humanity: it is the resting place of High King Thoradin, the founder of Arathor, and the root origin of Tirisfal's name and early human reverence for the Silver Hand.
The legendary Keeper Tyr gave his life here fighting cosmic evil, leaving behind the archetype of self-sacrifice and the silver hand icon that forms the spiritual foundation of paladin orders.
